subject: Compact demo timebox & handoff matrix for Clearwave trial
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena@clearwave.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Clearwave inbound trial — intro + availability

Hey team,

Inbound from Clearwave (self-serve signup earlier today). Elena Morales (IT/security) is the primary contact on their side. Lead notes attached (clearwave-intake.json).

Quick ask: can we pull together a compact 30–45 minute intro/demo next week that includes AE + SE + a short IT/security handoff? They're particularly time-constrained — asked for a tight timebox and a technical checklist pre-flight.

Suggested windows (in their local TZ PST):
- Tue 2027-11-16 — 09:00–09:45 PST
- Wed 2027-11-17 — 16:00–16:45 PST
- Thu 2027-11-18 — 11:30–12:15 PST

If AE/SE can lock one, I’ll send the calendar invite and include the intake + HubSpot deal (HS-920384). Rohan, want to own AE lead? Soojin, can you confirm SE availability and whether a 30-min technical pre-check makes sense?

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter | SDR, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: clearwave-intake.json (application/json, 8KB)
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena@clearwave.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clearwave inbound trial — intro + availability

Thanks Ben — I can take point as AE.

Elena — hi, great to meet you. Short agenda proposal for a 35-minute slot:
- 0–5 min: quick intros & goals (AE)
- 5–20 min: product demo focused on latency/cost controls (AE + SE)
- 20–30 min: SE-led technical checklist + Q&A for IT/security
- 30–35 min: next steps (trial activation, contacts, any procurement notes)

From our side Soojin will cover the security/port/region questions. If you have a security contact or a short checklist we should review before the call, please attach. Otherwise we can run a quick pre-check 15 minutes ahead.

I can do Wed 11/17 at 16:00 PST (that aligns well with my calendar). If that works for Elena, Ben can send the invite and include a calendar note with the pre-check link.

Best,
Rohan

--
Rohan Mehta | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rohan_mehta@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0122
From: Elena Morales <elena@clearwave.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: security-team@clearwave.com
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clearwave inbound trial — intro + availability

Thanks, Rohan. We appreciate the tight agenda. A couple of notes from IT/security: 

- We prefer a 30-minute slot (tight schedule).
- SE (Soojin) will need to confirm that we can open the following egress ports to the Redwood endpoint: 443 outbound only; no inbound SSH.
- We have an internal compliance checklist; attaching the file (security-checklist.docx). If you can confirm items marked with * by EOD Wednesday, we’ll be able to join the Wed 16:00 PST slot.

Also, would prefer to have the pre-check 20 minutes prior (15 is OK) to validate network flows.

Elena Morales
Head of IT & Security | Clearwave Systems
elena@clearwave.com | +1 (206) 555-4477

Attachment: security-checklist.docx (Microsoft Word, 42KB)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@clearwave.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 11:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clearwave inbound trial — intro + availability

On Mon, Nov 8, 2027 at 11:15 AM Elena Morales <elena@clearwave.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Rohan. We appreciate the tight agenda. A couple of notes from IT/security:
> - We prefer a 30-minute slot (tight schedule).
> - SE (Soojin) will need to confirm that we can open the following egress ports to the Redwood endpoint: 443 outbound only; no inbound SSH.
> - We have an internal compliance checklist; attaching the file (security-checklist.docx). If you can confirm items marked with * by EOD Wednesday, we’ll be able to join the Wed 16:00 PST slot.

Confirmed — 30 minutes works fine. I reviewed the checklist: items marked * look like standard telemetry/retention flags we already have docs for. I’ll prepare the POC preflight doc and send as a single-page attachment (POC-setup-checklist.pdf).

We can run the pre-check at 15 minutes before the meeting (15 min buffer should be enough to validate 443 only). If Elena prefers 20 minutes, I can be earlier.

I’ll also note any region-specific config — Clearwave is on us-west by default; we’ll verify model region and data retention settings during the call.

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0277

If anything changes I’ll post here, otherwise I’ll mark this thread as the canonical scheduling thread and follow up with a calendar invite and meeting notes after Ben sends the invite.

Thanks all — looking forward to it.
